A pioneering aerial device developed by the Nuian inventor, Flite, of the Crescent Throne. Driven by a desire to soar from the peak of Solzrean toward the sea, it may lack speed and acceleration, but it allows even first-time pioneers to remain afloat due to its gentle descent. · Flight Speed: ★★☆☆☆ · Airtime: ★★☆☆☆ · Maneuverability: ★★☆☆☆ · Handling Difficulty: Easy

The Andelph dwarf Flugel enhanced Flite's glider with additional levitation stones and a steering system designed to hold its course. Compared to the prototype, it offers improved speed, acceleration, and handling. · Flight Speed: ★★★☆☆ · Airtime: ★★★☆☆ · Maneuverability: ★★★☆☆ · Handling Difficulty: Medium
